summary: Instinct Bio Technical Company Holdings Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 4, 2026, with an operational update. The update covers progress on its first GENR VER CLINIC site in Jakarta, Indonesia, including securing premises and target opening by end of December 2026, and product development with Invitrx Therapeutics and PT Parva Candela. It announces preliminary subscription pricing tiers but no financial terms, transactions, or strategic events. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
